512-950-2691.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.

512-950-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

2131-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4369-5231-6847.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-5231-6847.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Weftstalker Ardent triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1479-4693-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-5702.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

654-2570-3519-5531.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Lumra, adding seven {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Lumra to the command zone from exile.
Activate Command Beacon's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Lumra from the command zone into your hand.
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

511-817-851-4050-6774.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

141-2438-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

1477-3284-3490-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
1477-3284-3490-4871.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-5231-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3020-5686-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-5686-6701.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1231-2292-4826-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2292-2577-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2292-2577-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2292-2577-4871.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.

Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

2085-2872-4639.notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
2085-2872-4639.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

225-2800-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-2800-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1707-2818-3297-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Floating Shield attached to Bishop of Wings.
"Black" chosen with Floating Shield.
You control at least one Spirit with toughness equal to 1, and a way to deal damage to that creature.
1707-2818-3297-4302.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Angel" on Bishop of Wings to "Spirit".
Deal damage to a Spirit you control with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Bishop of Wings' second ability and Last Laugh.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers , causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Last Laugh trigger, dealing 1 damage to each creature except Bishop of WIngs, as well as each player.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-1537-4751-5147.notablePrerequisites: Zealous Conscripts and Verduous Gearhulk do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
1365-1537-4751-5147.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Zealous Conscripts persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Zealous Conscripts.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk.
When Verdurous Gearhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Zealous Conscripts, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1512-1636-2277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Wizards.
1512-1636-2277.description:
Activate Supreme Inquisitor by tapping it, Stonybrook Schoolmaster, and any other three Wizards you control.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
When the Merfolk Wizard enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Supreme Inquisitor ability, causing you to search a player's library for five cards and exile them.
Repeat.

549-643-1558-3413.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
549-643-1558-3413.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
